facts.value: Provides shared mutable effect allocator metadata and global creation-mode, creation-accounting-counter, and pending-animation-count storage. efLib_EffectCount accounts for mode-0 creation, named EF_LOADKIND_ASYNC, but is not an infallible live-object count because creation increments it before allocation and does not roll back effect-allocation failure.

facts.rationale: Adds useful allocator and failure-path knowledge while repairing the unsupported literal allocator-size claim and preserving cross-file lifetime and queue semantics.
facts.value: efLib_Init configures efLib_AllocData using sizeof(EF_Effect) with alignment argument 4U and resets efLib_EffectCount, without explicitly resetting efLib_LoadKind or efLib_AnimCount. EF_Effect has a source size annotation of 0x2C; its compiled layout remains unresolved, and the HSD_ObjAllocData size assertion does not prove EF_Effect's size. Mode-0 creation attempts eviction at count >= 64 and increments before allocation. Effect-allocation failure leaves that increment unrolled back; GObj-allocation failure reaches the duplicate-free assertion branch. Cleanup decrements only for non-NULL effect->gobj and is_async == 0, then frees through efLib_AllocData. Animated models increment AnimCount and store at its prior index before checking >= 32; dispatch epilogues predecrement and animate indexed entries until the signed count equals zero.
